Name: Portable Home Theater Furniture
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
[size=3]This mod adds a bunch of furniture you can use to create a theater anywhere. I made a animated projection screen that you can use together with a projector, it plays a different movie every day. When theater is unlocked, tickets and posters can be bought from any ticket booth!

Where do I find everything? Carpenter's Shop, JojaMart and inside the Ticket Booth or Box Office. 

Mods I recommend:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15458]Wickedy's Theater Concessions Vending Machine[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13182]Popcorn Machine[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14387]Light Mod[/url]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16395]Movie Theatre Tweaks[/url]






To install you need to unzip the mod to your mods folder.

I also tried to do the theater chair but found no other sprites, so you have to flip it.

Please post if you find any bugs, Thank you!
